Elevation runs from 463 m at Rawa Pening Lake to 3,371 m at Mountain Sumbing. Hard: more than 22 km or 800 m of ascent in a day, or ground above 3,000 m. The longest day is 20 km, with up to 1244 m of ascent. Distances are straight lines between stops, not trail distance; 84.9 km in total.
